identity.title: [v0.92][Runtime Security] Make lifecycle TLS authority config-only

values.task_boundary: Remove duplicated lifecycle TLS command inputs and preserve the existing Runtime lifecycle behavior through config-only authority.
deliverables: focused Rust and executable lifecycle regression coverage
acceptance_criteria: lifecycle soak rejects the removed TLS path flags
certificate chain, private key, and trust roots are loaded only from Runtime init configuration
configured TLS files are validated fail closed without leaking path or key material
Guardian fixture places TLS paths only in generated configuration
HTTPS and WSS lifecycle proof passes with config-owned TLS
issue #268 can consume the merged fix without a TLS argv surface
dependencies: current Runtime v3 init configuration schema
issue #268 paid AWS qualification waits for this merge
